tools.name: find_patent_citations
tools.title: Find citing and cited patents
tools.description: List documents cited by a US patent and documents that cite it, using USPTO grant references and USPTO office-action citations. The PatentsView citation graph is paused. Not legal advice.

direction.description: citing: documents that cite this patent. cited_by: documents this patent cites. both is the default.

tools.name: get_patent
tools.title: Get patent details
tools.description: Fetch one US patent's title, abstract, claims, status, family, and citations from USPTO. Missing text is omitted rather than filled in. Not legal advice.

patentNumber.description: US patent or publication number, such as US10000000 or 10000000.

tools.name: search_patents
tools.title: Search patents
tools.description: Search public US patent records by keywords, claim language, CPC class, assignee, inventor, or grant date. Every number in the result was returned by USPTO. Not legal advice.

keywords.description: Words to find in the application or title and abstract.

claims.description: Claim language. USPTO matches these words across the file wrapper.

cpc.description: CPC symbol, such as H04L or C07H19/207.

dateFrom.description: Grant or publication date from, YYYY-MM-DD.

dateTo.description: Grant or publication date to, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: search_prior_art
tools.title: Search prior art
tools.description: Turn an idea description into a public-patent search and return the closest records the offices actually returned, with Google Patents links. Ranking counts overlapping words. It is not a patentability opinion. Not legal advice.

idea.description: What the invention is, in plain language.
